description: Source code for a Linux kernel module that manages u-boot environment stored in RAM, including device registration, memory mapping, and file operations.

methods.name: to_ubootenv_drvdata
methods.description: Converts a file pointer to the driver data structure.

methods.name: ubootenv_write
methods.description: Writes data to the u-boot environment buffer.

methods.name: ubootenv_read
methods.description: Reads data from the u-boot environment buffer.

methods.name: ubootenv_llseek
methods.description: Seeks within the u-boot environment buffer.

methods.name: ubootenv_ioctl
methods.description: Handles ioctl commands for the u-boot environment device.

methods.name: ubootenv_probe
methods.description: Initializes the device, maps memory, and registers the device.

methods.name: ubootenv_remove
methods.description: Cleans up the device on removal.
